description: This file implements an authentication context for a React application using Next.js. It defines user-related types, creates and manages an AuthContext with methods for login, registration, and logout, and handles user state and route protection based on authentication status.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access authentication context; must be used within an AuthProvider.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React component that provides authentication state and methods to child components, managing user login, registration, and route redirection based on auth status.
